in_sanskrit.name: Lakesh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lake dweller
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Lakesh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Laksh', meaning 'goal' or 'goalpost'. In Hindu mythology, Lakesh refers to a lake dweller, often associated with the god Varuna, the deity of water. The name carries a sense of tranquility and connection to nature.
